description: CR-only four-era Upsilon yields from original free-r S+B fits, compared with original B-only fits; no new minimizations.

results.error_method: Local Jacobian times complete free-r native covariance; second-order one-sided derivative near parameter boundaries.
results.caveat: Symmetric Hesse approximations only. Upsilon means at parameter boundaries and weak identifiability can make Gaussian intervals misleading; these are not validated profile intervals.
